name: Suddenly Royal
source: As a struggling grad student, you don’t believe in fairytales—until your life becomes one. When you discover you’re the long-lost heiress to a duchy in the distant country of Lilaria, you’re forced to admit that maybe fairy tales do come true.
translation: As a struggling grad student, you don’t believe in fairytales—until your life becomes one. When you discover you’re the long-lost heiress to a duchy in the distant country of Lilaria, you’re forced to admit that maybe fairy tales do come true.
